Name: Sam Replacement Portrait
Author: feralfinch
Description:
Hello! I'm an artist who recently started playing Stardew Valley and fell in love. When I discovered portrait mods and how easy they were to implement, I wanted to try my hand. So I have created a series of vanilla inspired characters with a little more detail and a little more flare.

This little sunshine boy and his unfortunate hairdo, out there with higher hair than a southern belle in the 80s. I flipped back and forth between blue and green eyes a few times. His sprite appears to have green eyes while his portrait has blue. In the end, I thought blue suited his color palette better. Our little punk gets some piercings and a faded denim jacket, too. And dimples. Sam needs dimples.

[i]Revamped Sam's face and coloring. He was the first I started working on so my pixel skills were still pretty rusty![/i]

+ Requires Content Patcher & SMAPI
[list]
[*]Download my file and unzip
[*]Extract folder into steam/steamapps/common/stardewvalley/mods
[*]Content Patcher must have been run at least once for mods to take effect
[/list]
